security_boundary.source: Model-controlled approval tool target/context and request lifecycle
security_boundary.invariant: Every approval byte is visibly represented before fullscreen approval unlocks; an answer owned by an expired request must never become ordinary user input.
security_boundary.strategy: Strict checked-in Unicode approval presentation at shared line/curses boundaries, column-safe shared drawing, and explicit request-owned drafts through the line boundary.
security_boundary.legitimate_control: Supported spacing Unicode remains readable; target execution and submitted answer bytes remain unchanged; redirected/structured output policies stay unchanged.

visibility_negative_control.boundary: The same native ApprovalReview/CursesText helper compiled against baseline and changed Release builds, en_US.UTF-8, real 10x40 curses screen.
visibility_negative_control.trigger: A tag character inside config.json and nine combining marks after e. Both pages render successfully and reach review completion.
visibility_negative_control.alternate_coverage: Real wide-cell tests cover tags, selectors, joiners, CGJ, Hangul fillers, enclosing marks, excessive combining marks, malformed bytes, controls and literal escape-looking text.

draft_negative_control.baseline: Exit 1: deterministic gated ordinary prefix lost in both line/curses modes.
draft_negative_control.changed: Pass in full Debug and ASan/UBSan and all twenty focused PTY batches.

limits.pending_review: Complete and independently owned; not truncated to history budgets.
limits.redraw: Cached preparation; only a visible suffix is copied. No full-answer preparation/allocation on unchanged redraw.
limits.allocation_failure: Clear partial input cache, preserve original exception, allow fresh input.

static_analysis.interpretation: Cppcheck passes. Local Clang-Tidy and Clang Analyzer retain nonzero exits from exactly the baseline diagnostics: five source warnings plus one SDK13-incomplete translation unit for Tidy, and the existing context.cpp division warning. Current input hashes match final source. No suppressions/check weakening. Ubuntu mandatory analysis passes.

linux_ci.coverage: Wide curses explicitly selected; CODET_REQUIRE_UTF8_CURSES=1 makes actual Unicode cell/wrapping coverage mandatory; build, analyzer selftests, all-source analysis and complete CTest pass.

earlier_failure_evidence.observation: One initial sanitizer failure on case-insensitive macOS; exact baseline Release reproduced 2/100 failures, changed focused ASan 0/20. Assertions unchanged.

Intermediate sanitizer failure exposed an ordinary input prefix lost at worker completion. Fixed with explicit ordinary-draft retention. The new gated negative control fails baseline in both modes; final full suites and repetitions pass.

One intermediate macOS Child process setup failed exception; root cause unestablished. Focused 100 baseline and 100 changed reruns both pass. This is not classified as a confirmed baseline defect. Final full suites pass.
earlier_failure_evidence.original_full_log: Overwritten by later runs; the original driver summary remains. Do not treat the later passing full log as original failure evidence.

earlier_failure_evidence.observation: New development-time static findings were fixed in source. Final diagnostic multisets match baseline without suppressions.

performance.method: Two isolated measurement sets; one warm-up and five alternating measured runs per workload per variant, reversing ordering per sample. No concurrent local analyzers/tests. Identical compiler/settings and copied harnesses.

verification.syscall_positive_controls: 128 calls each for write, fstat, fcntl and fpathconf in every sample

performance.interpretation: The helper boundary removes quadratic input preparation and bounds history. A 64 KiB incremental ASCII input prepares 131071 bytes instead of 2147516416; cumulative C++ allocation bytes fall from 8592750241 to 7206468. A 256-redraw workload prepares zero new input bytes and copies only the viewport. Thirty 2 MiB history requests retain 262144 payload bytes instead of 62914590. These are helper/harness measurements, not complete interactive terminal latency. Diagnostic/export counters are unchanged. Small export medians are about 1.9%/1.8% slower; large export medians about 0.6%/0.1% faster. No general diagnostic/export speedup is claimed.
performance.counter_limits: C++ operator new and directly interposed native calls; not all libc/libedit allocations or I/O. No timing-based CI thresholds.
